hpi: Case Summary: Giardiasis is an infection caused by the parasite Giardia lamblia. It is important to consider this diagnosis in patients presenting with diarrhea, especially if they have traveled recently or have been exposed to contaminated water. The treatment of choice is metronidazole, but other antiparasitic agents will kill Giardia as well. It is also important to ensure that the patient is hydrated, as dehydration can be a significant concern with diarrhea. Additionally, educating the patient about the importance of proper hygiene and avoiding contaminated food and water sources is crucial in preventing future infections.
